text: The text contains sarcasm in the first two sentences. The speaker claims to "love" when their phone dies during an important call and calls it the "best feature of modern technology," which is clearly ironic because phone battery failure is a frustrating and undesirable event. This sarcasm flips the sentiment polarity of those specific statements from positive (as suggested by the literal words "love" and "best") to negative, reflecting annoyance or frustration. The final sentence is a factual question and does not contain sarcasm.
